_comment: Layout, sizing and typography for radio-buttons. Colours come from the Figma colour mirror; these do not, so they are authored here.

_source.ring-width: 4px, read off the focus variants of `radio-buttons` (14457:1351) on 2026-08-19: a DROP_SHADOW with blur 0, offset 0 and spread 4 — which is the same construct as the `0 0 0 Npx` ring the component renders. Previously 3, labelled 'storybook-local, no Figma token backs it'. Figma did state it; nobody had looked.
_source.ring-colour: The same effect carries the colour at 40% alpha: #D4D4D4 on an unselected radio and #22C55E on a selected one. That matches `--radio-ring-gray` and the green ring already generated from the colour mirror, so no new token is needed.

_corrections.ring-width: Was 3 with a note claiming Figma states nothing. Figma states 4. The note was the error, not the value's absence — `storybook-local` was being used to mean 'not checked' rather than 'checked and genuinely absent'.

_verified_from.scope: all 6 variants: size, radius, border, dot, focus effect

_figma_icons._comment: The icons Figma instantiates for this component, read 2026-08-20 by walking the instance tree and keeping every main component whose parent set is `icons`. An icon Figma hides by default belongs in `icons` only when this component implements the state that reveals it; otherwise it is recorded under _figma_gaps instead, so the gate is not asking for a feature nobody built.

nodes.note: This component draws no icon at all in Figma. Recorded so that one appearing later has to be justified rather than slipping in.
